ex.en: He moved to a cheaper city to cut his living expenses.
ex.zh: 他搬到消费较低的城市以削减生活开支。

words.note: expenses 指各项开支；at the expense of 表“以…为代价”。

ex.en: The explorers traversed the frozen desert in only three weeks.
ex.zh: 探险者仅用三周就穿越了冰封的荒漠。

words.note: traverse 指横穿较大区域，比 cross 正式，多用于书面语。

ex.en: All new employees must complete a rigorous training program.
ex.zh: 所有新员工都必须完成严格的培训项目。

words.note: rigorous 侧重标准严格、逻辑严密，常修饰 training、analysis。

ex.en: She yelled at the driver to watch where he was going.
ex.zh: 她冲着司机大喊，让他看好路。

words.note: yell at sb 含责备意味；yell for help 是大声呼救。

ex.en: The museum has a large collection of contemporary Chinese art.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了大量中国当代艺术作品。

words.note: contemporary 指同一时代或当代，常修饰艺术、社会。

ex.en: The tribe has lived in the mountains for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 这个部落已在山中生活了数百年。

words.note: tribe 指部落；衍生词 tribal 意为“部落的”。

ex.en: You need to click the link to activate your new account.
ex.zh: 你需要点击链接来激活新账户。

words.note: activate 指使设备或账户开始起作用，常接 account、alarm。

ex.en: The government mobilized volunteers to help with the flood relief.
ex.zh: 政府动员志愿者参与洪灾救援。

words.note: mobilize 强调把人力、资源组织起来投入行动。

ex.en: Students take two mock exams before the real test.
ex.zh: 学生在正式考试前要参加两次模拟考。

words.note: mock 作定语表“模拟的”，mock exam、interview 很常见。

ex.en: We traveled to the village by minibus because the road was narrow.
ex.zh: 因道路狭窄，我们乘小巴去了那个村子。

words.note: minibus 指可载十余人小巴，常用 by minibus。

ex.en: Factory work can be boring and highly repetitive.
ex.zh: 工厂工作可能枯燥且高度重复。

words.note: repetitive 带贬义，指单调重复；名词形式是 repetition。

ex.en: The shops are gearing up for the holiday season.
ex.zh: 商店正为假期购物季做准备。

words.note: gear up for 表示“为…做准备”，shift gears 指换挡或转变。

ex.en: The new software is designed to facilitate communication between teams.
ex.zh: 这款新软件旨在促进团队间的沟通。

words.note: facilitate 后接抽象名词，意为“使…更容易”，不接人。

ex.en: The sudden cut in funding could precipitate a serious crisis.
ex.zh: 突然削减资金可能引发一场严重危机。

words.note: precipitate 作动词读 /prɪˈsɪpɪteɪt/，指使某事突然发生。

ex.en: She is endowed with a remarkable talent for languages.
ex.zh: 她天生具有非凡的语言天赋。

words.note: be endowed with 表“天生具有”，也可指捐资设立基金。

ex.en: The company is facing serious financial difficulties this year.
ex.zh: 公司今年面临严重的财务困难。

words.note: financial 修饰与钱相关的事物；注意 finance 是名词或动词。

ex.en: After the meeting, they returned to their respective offices.
ex.zh: 会议结束后，他们各自回到了办公室。

words.note: respective 只作定语，修饰复数名词，后接名词不接 of。

ex.en: Her voice quivered with fear as she described the accident.
ex.zh: 她描述事故时，声音因恐惧而发颤。

words.note: quiver 指轻微快速的颤动，常与 with fear、anger 连用。

ex.en: Please book a time slot before you visit the clinic.
ex.zh: 去诊所前请先预约一个时间段。

words.note: slot 指狭长开口，也指日程中的时间段或空位。

ex.en: The clay will harden quickly once it is left in the sun.
ex.zh: 黏土放在太阳下很快就会变硬。

words.note: harden 指变硬、变坚强，也可说 harden one's heart。

ex.en: The fallen apples slowly rotted on the wet ground.
ex.zh: 掉落的苹果在湿地上慢慢腐烂。

words.note: rot 可作动词也可作名词，指木头、食物等腐烂。

ex.en: The dictionary defines the word in a very simple way.
ex.zh: 这本词典用很简单的方式给该词下定义。

words.note: define 常用被动 clearly defined 表“界定清楚的”。

ex.en: Experts predict that prices will rise sharply next year.
ex.zh: 专家预测明年物价将大幅上涨。

words.note: predict 后接名词或 that 从句；名词是 prediction。

ex.en: The teacher dictated a short passage to the class.
ex.zh: 老师给全班口授了一段短文。

words.note: dictate 可指口授，也可指强行规定；名词是 dictation。

ex.en: Many students try to memorize new words without using them.
ex.zh: 许多学生试图记单词却不去使用它们。

words.note: memorize 强调背诵记住；名词 memory 还可指记忆。

ex.en: The flood rendered the bridge completely useless for weeks.
ex.zh: 洪水使这座桥数周完全无法通行。

words.note: render 后接宾语加形容词，如 render sth useless。

ex.en: Constant criticism from parents can undermine a child's confidence.
ex.zh: 父母不断的批评会削弱孩子的自信心。

words.note: undermine 由 under 加 mine（挖）而来，指暗中逐渐削弱。

ex.en: Taste in music is highly subjective and varies from person to person.
ex.zh: 音乐品味很主观，因人而异。

words.note: subjective 主观，反义词 objective 客观，注意词根 subject。

ex.en: The cherry trees along the river blossom in early April.
ex.zh: 河边的樱花树四月初开花。

words.note: in blossom 表“正在开花”，blossom into 指发展成为。

ex.en: The company has undergone radical changes in the past two years.
ex.zh: 这家公司在过去两年经历了根本性的变化。

words.note: radical 修饰 change、reform 时指彻底、根本性的变革。
